summary.description: One or two short sentences in plain English for a busy parent.

blocking.description: Problems that must be fixed before merge. Each needs concrete evidence.

suggestions.description: Judgement calls and nice-to-haves. Never block.

not_applicable.description: Checklist sections or items that do not apply to this PR.

screenshots.description: Extra screenshots you saved in review-shots/ (file name only) that show a finding or a screen the standard set misses.

evidence.description: Steps to reproduce with screen size, or file and line, or the command output.
